comments.text: Great video.  Did you get the motocross tune or the trail tune on the suspension? Thanks

comments.author: @sidluxurious7816
comments.text:
I've got a 23 model & have sorted the stock forks ( to the degree possible ) , have an EXT shock, lowered pegs, & several other mods to try & make it trail worthy .. & safe. 

The past year I have kind lost interest in the UB as my 250 KTM just feels so much more comfortable over rough terrain, but I don't love the 240+ lbs weight of the thing.
It's apparent that all these e-bikes with a 53" - ish wheelbase are simply too short except for smooth terrain, they are a scalpel & tons of fun in those conditions.  

If fitting this swingarm - are there any other issues needing resolved like brake lines, jackshaft mods & such ? 
Do the stock linkage components fit up properly ? 
It's a given that a new longer chain would be in order, so thats expected. 
Guess a new swingarm would be excuse enough for finally taking apart & servicing the jackshaft arrangement .. not looking forward to that battle. 
Thanks for the content, carry on.

comments.author: @bryandanielowen
comments.text: Yes Sir.. the P211 COMBAT is my go to! I’ve always loved Sig! Right or wrong…. Ever since Point Break and Keanu running his P228. I’ve always just loved the appearance over every other double/single action, say like a Smith 5904 or the likes (my dad’s bed side). I’ve owned plenty of Sigs… SP2009, SP2040. Legion 229 (when they first came out) which is my favorite but… the P211 is DYNAMITE!!!!  Look at the Lok grips! The palm swell is perfect. Solid brass. Wish I could send you photo of what it looks like! Anyway… well done, great choice! My only complaint about the pistol… the need for a dumb tool to take down and field strip the unit! Absolutely stupid! Sig needs to make the slide lever easily removable! Or some aftermarket company!
